lines.say: In 1984, Pizza Hut started paying kids in pizza to read.
Hit your teacher's reading goal, and you got a free personal pan pizza.
And the goals reset every month, up to six a year.
Pizza Hut says about sixty million kids joined over thirty years. A reason to come back, every month.
Been a minute. Chair's open Thursday.
